integrity: Full proof and complete finite verifier source are supplied; finite exhaustive experiments confirm their tested instances but do not prove the theorem over infinite spaces.
limitations: Positive exact-verification distributivity only; no preclusion/negative-content criterion, no axiomatization or infinite computational decision result. Four-state counts are for the labeled Boolean join-semilattice only. Potential generic join-operator reformulations remain a literature risk.
title: Exact permission distributivity via join-generated witnesses
